scope: fresh held-out sourceTEST100 only; freshtrain100 unused; no parameter tuning on these scores

v2_minus_v1.metric: observed-facts mean log-loss difference; candidate minus reference; negative favors candidate
v2_minus_v1.unit: whole battle; equally weighted revelations within selected battles
v2_minus_v1.limits: Does not control repeated-player or repeated-roster dependence; source-time leakage limits remain retrospective.

v2_minus_baseline.metric: observed-facts mean log-loss difference; candidate minus reference; negative favors candidate
v2_minus_baseline.unit: whole battle; equally weighted revelations within selected battles
v2_minus_baseline.limits: Does not control repeated-player or repeated-roster dependence; source-time leakage limits remain retrospective.

metric_context: Frozen legacy prefix model: current before-state item/ability filtering unchanged; other chat native_facts/original_set_before edits excluded.
source_time_limit: Pinned curated and usage sources postdate some historical replays; retrospective, not prospective deployment evidence.
move_model: Uniform over a candidate's not-yet-observed moves; this mixes set support and move/reveal selection.
no_hidden_spread_labels: Nature, EVs and IVs are not scored because they are not revealed ground truth.
interpretation_limit: Prediction loss is not a battle-strength or calibrated action-policy metric; no model is promoted from this result.
